policy: Every item is a local sentence edit or composition. Acceptance requires grammar, coherence, scientific plausibility, public-source fidelity AND preservation of the approved initial anchor claims. Material deletions, causal or modal strengthening, and garbled text fail; uncertainty remains unapproved. Stylistic awkwardness alone is not a material failure. Exact text is assessed without silently repairing it.
